desc: Ideate approaches and select boundary-window DP over merged safe segments.
Implement complete Python solution using boundary-window DP over merged safe segments.
Merge bad intervals that touch or overlap, and early reject if any merged bad block has length >= B.
Build non-empty safe segments between merged bad blocks.
Precompute can_sum(d) exactly using Dijkstra on residues modulo A with edge weights A..B, handling d=0 and negative d correctly.
Store first-B positions of each safe segment in a position-to-segment map and initialize reachable entries with square 1.
For each segment, compute reachable last-B exits from reachable entries using can_sum, then propagate jumps of lengths A..B to first-B entries of later segments.
Track whether square N becomes reachable and print Yes or No accordingly.
Verify the implementation on samples and edge cases such as M=0, A=B, adjacent bad intervals, short safe segments, and bad blocks too long to cross.
